habakkuk.1.p1.b1.text: This is the burden that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision:

habakkuk.1.p1.b2.text: How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?

habakkuk.1.p1.b3.text: Why do You make me see iniquity? Why do You tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me. Strife is ongoing, and conflict abounds.

habakkuk.1.p1.b4.text: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth. For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.

habakkuk.1.p1.b5.text: Look at the nations and observe— be utterly astounded! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe even if someone told you.

habakkuk.1.p1.b6.text: For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans — that ruthless and impetuous nation which marches through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.

habakkuk.1.p1.b7.text: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.

habakkuk.1.p1.b8.text: They scoff at kings and make rulers an object of scorn. They laugh at every fortress and build up siege ramps to seize it.

habakkuk.1.p1.b9.text: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass on through. They are guilty; their own strength is their god.”

habakkuk.1.p2.b1.text: Are You not from everlasting, O LORD, my God, my Holy One? We will not die.

habakkuk.1.p2.b2.text: O LORD, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.

habakkuk.1.p2.b3.text: Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil, and You cannot tolerate wrongdoing. … Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?

habakkuk.1.p2.b4.text: You have made men like the fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no ruler.

habakkuk.1.p2.b5.text: The foe pulls all of them up with a hook; he catches them in his dragnet, and gathers them in his fishing net; so he rejoices gladly.

habakkuk.1.p2.b6.text: Therefore he sacrifices to his dragnet and burns incense to his fishing net, for by these things his portion is sumptuous and his food is rich.

habakkuk.1.p2.b7.text: Will he, therefore, empty his net and continue to slay nations without mercy?
